meta_title: Smiths Garden Company | Landscape Gardener Southampton
meta_description: Smiths Garden Company is a Southampton landscape gardener specialising in garden design, planting, and maintenance. Free quotes available. Call today.
hero_subhead: Expert landscape design and maintenance that turns your outdoor space into a place you actually want to spend time in.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Landscape Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From initial design through to ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of creating and caring for beautiful outdoor spaces.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We listen to your vision and create detailed plans before any work begins.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Professional planting schemes using shrubs, perennials, and trees that thrive in Southampton's climate. We source quality plants and ensure expert installation.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Durable patios, pathways, and raised beds using quality materials. We design functional outdoor living areas that complement your home.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance packages including lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidying. Keep your garden looking pristine year-round.

services.title: Lawn Care & Seeding
services.desc: Lawn treatments, overseeding, and expert maintenance to achieve a lush, healthy grass area. We handle aeration, feeding, and moss control.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Work
services.desc: Professional pruning, trimming, and removal of trees and hedges. We keep growth under control whilst maintaining plant health and garden aesthetics.

about_pullquote: We believe every garden deserves expert care and attention to detail.
about_para_1: Smiths Garden Company has been creating and maintaining beautiful gardens across Southampton and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. What started as a passion for landscape design has grown into a trusted local business, with a reputation built on quality workmanship and genuine customer relationships.
about_para_2: We specialise in turning overgrown or uninspiring outdoor spaces into gardens you'll love to spend time in. Our team takes time to understand your vision and deliver results that exceed expectations. Many of our customers come back year after year for maintenance — that's the kind of service we pride ourselves on.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had a neglected back garden that we didn't know where to start with. Smiths came out, listened to what we wanted, and the transformation was incredible. They managed the whole project from design to planting. Really professional and good value.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Been using Smiths for maintenance for three years now. They're reliable, thorough, and actually care about the garden. Always turn up on time and the lawn looks fantastic. Can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Mark P.

reviews.text: Had a massive overgrown hedge sorted in a day. The team were tidy, professional, and kept the costs reasonable. Much better than the quotes I got elsewhere. Will be booking them again for spring planting.
reviews.author: Emma K.
